title: Introduce token timeline cohorter and adaptive alert envelope
author: Sofia Morales
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky on first run, rerun)

description: Motivation: Long-tail latency and token-level cost regressions show up only when sliced by token position and model stage. Existing heatmaps and aggregate percentiles hide cohort drift. This PR introduces a Token Timeline Cohorter metric family and an Adaptive Alert Envelope that computes dynamic alert bands per-model/per-stage based on time-sliced token distributions. Summary of changes: add a new telemetry collector (telemetry/token_timeline_collector.go) that emits histograms keyed by model, stage, token_idx_bucket and shard; implement an envelope_aggregator service that computes EWMA-based upper/lower envelopes and MAD-derived noise floors; extend the metrics schema (pkg/metrics/schema_v2.md) with the new time_slice histogram type; add dashboard panels (dashboards/token_timeline_cohorts.json and dashboards/token_time_envelope_panel.json) showing small-multiple cohort lanes and an overlayed adaptive envelope; introduce an alert rule (rules/alerts/token-timeline-envelope.yaml) that uses the envelope as a soft alert with auto-tune parameters turned on by default only behind a feature flag; add e2e replaybench tests and an integration harness for validating cohort stability under synthetic bursts. Rollout plan: feature flag telemetry.timeline.enabled=false by default; enable in staging for 48h with high-sample synthetic replay then soft-enable in prod for 5% tenants for 72h; monitor false-positive rate and envelope sensitivity, then gradual ramp to 100%. Backwards compatibility: schema v2 is additive; migration script provided (scripts/migrate-metrics-v1-to-v2.sh) for ingestion backfills. Performance: aggregator is sharded and rate-limited; estimated CPU increase for telemetry workers ~6% at current ingestion, measured on staging. Security/privacy: cohort keys are hashed and pseudonymized, documented in docs/observability/token-timeline.md. Checklist: - [x] metrics schema and generator; - [x] aggregator service with unit tests; - [x] dashboard JSON and panel unit-check; - [x] alert rule with auto-tune parameters and docs; - [x] migration script and rollout plan; - [x] e2e replaybench validation and staging run notes. Testing: unit tests added for envelope math and edge cases; integration tests run via GitHub Actions with a rerun on first flaky failure; replaybench scenarios validated in staging with 10k synthetic invocations demonstrating envelope adherence and reduced false positives compared to static-threshold baseline. Related: ENG-4821 (observability initiative), ENG-4999 (alert auto-tune baseline), SUP-7812 (customer request for per-token tail RCA).

release_notes: Introduce Token Timeline Cohorter and Adaptive Alert Envelope: new time-sliced token histograms, envelope-based soft alerts to reduce false positives on long-tail token latency regressions, dashboards for cohort visualization, and rollout behind feature flag. Opt-in for enterprise auto-tune. See docs/observability/token-timeline.md for usage and migration steps.
